import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.multiclass import OneVsRestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV
import os

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Define target columns in exact order
target_cols = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

# Get training text and test IDs
X_train_text = train["comment_text"]
test_ids = test["id"].values

# Create TF-IDF vectorizer with optimized character n-gram features
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(1, 3),
    max_features=100000,
    min_df=1,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    norm="l1",
)
X_train_vec_full = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_text.values)

# Hyperparameter optimization using cross-validation on training data only
base_clf = LogisticRegression(
    max_iter=1000, random_state=42, solver="lbfgs", class_weight="balanced"
)
param_grid = {"alpha": [0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1], "max_iter": [500, 1000, 2000]}
grid_search = GridSearchCV(
    base_clf, param_grid, cv=5, scoring="roc_auc", n_jobs=-1, return_train_score=True
)
grid_search.fit(X_train_vec_full, train[target_cols].astype(int).values.ravel())

# Train final model with optimal parameters
optimal_clf = grid_search.best_estimator_
clf_final = OneVsRestClassifier(base_clf)

# Split training data into train and validation sets (holdout)
n_samples = X_train_vec_full.shape[0]
split_idx = int(n_samples * 0.85)
X_train_data = X_train_vec_full[:split_idx]
X_val_data = X_train_vec_full[split_idx:]

# Extract labels consistently using iloc matching the dataframe index positions
y_train_data = train.iloc[:split_idx][target_cols].values.astype(int)
y_val_data = train.iloc[split_idx:][target_cols].values.astype(int)

print(
    f"Training data size: {X_train_data.shape[0]}, Validation data size: {X_val_data.shape[0]}"
)

# Evaluate using validation metrics BEFORE fitting on any new data
val_preds_proba = clf_final.predict_proba(X_val_data)

col_aucs = []
for col_idx, col_name in enumerate(target_cols):
    y_true = y_val_data[:, col_idx]
    pred_probs = val_preds_proba[:, col_idx]
    if len(np.unique(y_true)) > 1:
        col_auc = roc_auc_score(y_true, pred_probs)
        col_aucs.append(col_auc)
        print(f"ROC-AUC for {col_name}: {col_auc:.6f}")

mean_auc = sum(col_aucs) / len(col_aucs) if col_aucs else 0.0
print(f"Mean column-wise ROC AUC on held-out validation: {mean_auc:.6f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(test["comment_text"].values)
y_pred_proba_test = clf_final.predict_proba(X_test_vec)

# Create submission file with correct ordering based on sample_submission structure
if "id" in sample_submission.columns:
    submit = sample_submission.copy()
else:
    submit = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids})
    submit["toxic"] = y_pred_proba_test[:, 0]
    submit["severe_toxic"] = y_pred_proba_test[:, 1]
    submit["obscene"] = y_pred_proba_test[:, 2]
    submit["threat"] = y_pred_proba_test[:, 3]
    submit["insult"] = y_pred_proba_test[:, 4]
    submit["identity_hate"] = y_pred_proba_test[:, 5]

submit.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
